scope: Three-variable R12 box; six fixed financial parameters; native static financial boundary and declared finite 40-state generator, emissions and prior. Not a continuum neural/free-boundary solution, full equity/debt kernel, gradients or production qualification.
cases: Eight corners plus64 new uniform draws in R12 box; 129 normal-CDF arguments including 97 fixed grid and32 new random points; seven out-of-profile rejections. All attempted valid cases retained, any valid failure fails gate.
independent_references: Untouched R12 Cell/R11 FullHX plus independent80digit mpmath direct divided differences; native evaluates B by derivative quadrature and Phi by a positive tail integral.
positive_normal_tail: Phi(-u)=exp(-u*u/2)/sqrt(2*pi)*integral_0^12 exp(-u*t-t*t/2)dt, twelve16-point Gauss-Legendre panels; neglected tail <= Phi(-12). No probability floor, clipping or normalization. This tail bound alone is not a uniform floating-point/quadrature proof.
publication: Exact source/protocol remotely published and read back before formal namespace is generated; formal output is separate from development and does not overwrite it.
